ranks: Need-keys Phase 2: cards freed by static grants through the look-and-choose and loyalty families (the families built 2026-10-30 to 2026-11-01; two agents of 75 cards, one blind reviewer)

authored.name: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia
Kytheon, Hero of Akros // Gideon, Battle-Forged
Invasion of New Phyrexia // Teferi Akosa of Zhalfir

blocked.name: Display of Dominance
blocked.why: Mode 2 is a turn-long rule covering permanents that arrive later; player-effect has no targeting restriction.

blocked.name: Cairn Wanderer
blocked.why: grantsActivatedOf gives only activated abilities, not the keywords (every landwalk and protection) it has as long as a creature card with them is in a graveyard.

blocked.name: Scheming Fence
blocked.why: grantsActivatedOf has no 'the chosen permanent' zone, and nothing stops the chosen permanent's activated abilities.

blocked.name: Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God
blocked.why: The +1's per-opponent choice between a card from hand and a permanent they control is missing.

blocked.name: Bigger on the Inside
blocked.why: The granted ability gives the target player mana and that player's next spell cascade; grant-spells-this-turn binds only its controller.

blocked.name: Archway of Innovation
blocked.why: grant-spells-this-turn has convoke but no improvise.

blocked.name: Acolyte of Bahamut
blocked.why: A costModification inside grantsStatic isn't applied (tested: the Dragon cost the full {4}{R}{R}).

blocked.name: Arterial Alchemy
blocked.why: A Blood token made an Equipment by addSubtypes offers the granted equip, but it resolves attaching nothing (tested).

blocked.name: Caduceus, Staff of Hermes
blocked.why: A granted 'prevent all damage that would be dealt to this creature' replacement isn't applied (tested).

blocked.name: Lymph Sliver
blocked.why: The granted absorb doesn't prevent (tested); a toFilter on the Sliver itself would outlive its losing its abilities.

blocked.name: Whipgrass Entangler
blocked.why: A combatTax given by grant-static isn't charged (tested: the creature attacked unpaid).

blocked.name: Quilled Greatwurm
blocked.why: GraveyardCastCosts has no 'remove N counters from among creatures you control'.

blocked.name: Scourge of Nel Toth
blocked.why: GraveyardCastCosts.sacrifice takes one permanent; it sacrifices two creatures.

blocked.name: Worldheart Phoenix
blocked.why: 'If you do, it enters with two +1/+1 counters': castVia graveyard-permission can't tell its own {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} cast from another permission's.

blocked.name: Skyclave Shade
blocked.why: grant-graveyard-cast takes only a target slot, not the source: no this-turn self permission from a landfall trigger.

blocked.name: Ark of Hunger
blocked.why: 'Mill a card. You may play that card this turn' needs a one-shot play permission for the milled card in the graveyard.

blocked.name: Emet-Selch of the Third Seat
blocked.why: 'Do this only once each turn' must count only an actual cast; 'one or more opponents lose life' batching is unproven too.

blocked.name: Kagha, Shadow Archdruid
blocked.why: One once-each-turn allowance covering both a land play and a permanent cast from the graveyard.

blocked.name: Serra Paragon
blocked.why: The same shared allowance, plus the granted 'exile it and you gain 2 life' trigger.

blocked.name: Raul, Trouble Shooter
blocked.why: The ruling separates milled cards from other library-to-graveyard moves, which putIntoGraveyardThisTurn doesn't.

blocked.name: Osteomancer Adept
blocked.why: A forage cost for casting creature cards from the graveyard, each entering with a finality counter.

blocked.name: Mission Briefing
blocked.why: It chooses a card rather than targeting one; grant-graveyard-cast is target-only.

blocked.name: Mavinda, Students' Advocate
blocked.why: grant-graveyard-cast has no '{8} more unless it targets a creature you control'.

blocked.name: Aven Interrupter
blocked.why: Its cost half is expressible, but no pool card exiles a target spell, and exile then become-plotted on a spell is unproven.

blocked.name: Commander Liara Portyr
blocked.why: This-turn reductions for spells cast from exile, and X the number of players being attacked.

blocked.name: Supper for Spiders
blocked.why: The returned cards must become Food artifacts and lose their other types for good.

blocked.name: Nashi, Moon Sage's Scion
blocked.why: 'You may play one of those cards': only one of the exiled cards.

blocked.name: Norn's Annex
blocked.why: attackTax takes generic mana or life, not {W/P}.

blocked.name: Shadow of Mortality
blocked.why: CostReductionAmount has no starting-life-minus-life count.

blocked.name: Fear of Abduction
blocked.why: The creature exiled for the additional cost isn't linked to the permanent the spell becomes, so 'each card exiled with it' misses it (rule 607.2q).

blocked.name: Synthesis Pod
blocked.why: No amount reads the mana value of the spell exiled as the cost, which the reveal-until's '1 plus' filter needs.

blocked.name: Catalyst Stone
blocked.why: No static changes only flashback costs, for you or for opponents.

blocked.name: Bolas's Citadel
blocked.why: castFromLibraryTop has no mandatory 'pay life equal to its mana value rather than its mana cost' for spells cast that way.

blocked.name: Plumb the Forbidden
blocked.why: 'When you do, copy this spell for each creature sacrificed' (AUTHORING §15).

blocked.name: Radiant Lotus
blocked.why: add-mana's who is a scope, not a target slot, and the colour is chosen as it resolves.

blocked.name: Rottenmouth Viper
blocked.why: For each blight counter, each opponent makes all their choices, then everything happens at once (rulings); repeating each-player-may does them one at a time.

blocked.name: Demilich
blocked.why: No cost-reduction amount counts the instant and sorcery spells you've cast this turn.

blocked.name: Terra, Magical Adept
blocked.why: No shape for 'if it's a Saga, put up to three lore counters on it' (a chosen number) on the token copy.

blocked.name: Vault 13: Dweller's Journey
blocked.why: In chapter III each owner orders their own cards on the bottom (ruling); look-and-choose's rest is ordered by the chooser or at random.

blocked.name: Cloak and Dagger, Entwined
blocked.why: One choice across the revealed hand's nonland cards and the targeted creature, exiled until it leaves.

blocked.name: Tegwyll's Scouring
blocked.why: Flash for an extra cost takes only mana, not 'tap three untapped creatures with flying'.

blocked.name: Turntimber Symbiosis // Turntimber, Serpentine Wood
blocked.why: withCounters can't be conditioned on the chosen card's mana value (3 or less).

blocked.name: Ghost Ark
blocked.why: No 'whenever this Vehicle becomes crewed' trigger.

blocked.name: Green Sun's Twilight
blocked.why: At X 5 or more, one hand-or-battlefield choice for the chosen cards, made after seeing them.

blocked.name: Kaito, Dancing Shadow
blocked.why: Only the static form exists; no one-shot 'twice this turn' for one planeswalker.

blocked.name: Urza Assembles the Titans
blocked.why: Chapter III needs the one-shot form for the planeswalkers you control.

blocked.name: Mutated Cultist
blocked.why: remove-player-counters takes one kind; no 'remove all counters' from a player, energy included.

blocked.name: Hurkyl's Final Meditation
blocked.why: No cost increase printed on a spell itself; cost:cost-increase-not-your-turn is Defense Grid's static on other spells.
